reason: The named lab and the batch report behind the QR code is what I actually look for, and the empty-box guarantee means a drawer-bottle risk is small. At $24.99 I would try one box, not two.
objection: It is only one form of magnesium, and other brands put several forms in one capsule. I also already have a drawer full of half-used bottles, so I may not finish it.
would_change_my_mind: If the lab report on the page turned out to be missing, generic, or not matching the batch number, I would not buy.
